component.name: molexMedia
component.summary: Batch, trim, and play media on FFmpeg

description.p: molexMedia is a desktop toolkit built on FFmpeg. It normalizes whole folders to named loudness standards such as EBU R 128, ATSC A/85, and Apple Podcasts, converts and compresses with the GPU, extracts audio, frames, GIFs, and subtitles, trims and edits on a timeline, and plays local files and links.
Every finished batch job is measured again and stamped with the loudness and true peak of its output. molexMedia downloads and verifies its own FFmpeg the first time it runs.
